findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Define the 'safe to retire' precondition for the reconcile-check pause decoder as 'no live pause blob carries gated_mode="reconcile-check"', and specify how in-flight/active pauses are drained or migrated before Child 3 removes the decoder.
evidence: AC3: 'Persisted historical reconcile-check data is migrated or read by a narrowly retained decoder until safe to retire.'
_ref_lock.py:658 rejects any pause whose gated_mode != 'reconcile-check' via RefLockCorruptError; :717 writes 'reconcile-check' into a live pause blob
The plan does not define how a LIVE pause active DURING the cutover window is drained/migrated before the decoder is retired (dual-write/live-state window)
findings.finding: AC3 defines the retire trigger as 'until safe to retire' but never states the concrete precondition that makes retirement safe — namely that no live pause blob still carries gated_mode="reconcile-check". A pause is on-demand persisted state that can be active at cutover; if the narrowly retained decoder (Child 3) is removed while such a pause is live, read_pause/_decode_pause fails-closed with RefLockCorruptError.
scenarios: A gate is paused with gated_mode='reconcile-check'; Child 3 lands and removes the decoder before the pause is cleared; read_pause raises RefLockCorruptError and gate operations fail-closed
findings.suggested_fix: In Child 2/3 add a cutover gate: before deleting the reconcile-check pause decoder, migrate any live pause blob in place (CAS-rewrite gated_mode to the new vocabulary) or require the gate be un-paused, and only then retire the legacy decoder.

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a back-out clause asserting that after any Child 2/3 rollback an in-flight pause/gate blob remains decodable (retain dual-vocabulary read tolerance across the rollback window, or forbid in-place rewrite until retirement is final), attaching a DATA LOSS RISK note if the transform is one-way.
evidence: Plan changes how existing persisted pause records are interpreted (retires/narrows the decoder) and may rewrite gated_mode in place
No AC or Approach clause asserts on the state of a pause/gate blob AFTER a Child 2/3 rollback — only that migration/retirement happens
_decode_pause raises RefLockCorruptError on any gated_mode mismatch (:658), so a mismatched decoder-vs-blob after rollback fails-closed
findings.finding: The plan does not assert the post-rollback interpretation of an in-flight pause/gate blob. If Child 2/3 rewrites persisted pause blobs to new vocabulary and is subsequently rolled back, the reverted (older or newer) decoder may reject the blob it now encounters, leaving the gate uninterpretable — a back-out that 'succeeds' while persisted state reads as corrupt.
scenarios: Child 3 lands, rewrites a live pause blob to new vocabulary, then is rolled back; the restored code's decoder no longer recognizes the rewritten blob and fails-closed
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the reconcile-check pause decoder read-tolerant on BOTH sides of the cutover (accept old and new gated_mode values during the window) so a rollback of Child 2/3 never encounters an undecodable blob; only drop old-value tolerance after all live pauses are confirmed drained.
